names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Νοεμβρίου, «Αγίες Κυριαίνα και Ιουλιανή», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on her name link behind the line for 1 ноября ст. ст., «Иулиания Россонская, мц.», with the rank word left off. The day's own line declines it as «Иулиании» and gives no by-name.

death.note: Two calendars on two different emperors of one name, and the interval holds both. saint.gr gave «Έζησαν στα χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Μαξιμιανού (298 μ.Χ.)», which this folder carried as about 298 and which falls in the reign of Maximian Herculius; days.pravoslavie.ru's life sets the arrest «при императоре Максимиане Галерии (305 - 311)», under Maximian Galerius, and its day line prints that reign as the entry's date. Nothing is chosen.

feast.note: Her name page lists this day and no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 ноября ст. ст. — «Мцц. Кириены и Иулиании (305-311).»

attestations.note: The line's «Мц.» is martyr, which this folder already held. The name link gives her the by-name «Иулиания Россонская», of Rhosus, which is the place the Greek life has the burning happen at and from which this folder's English form was already made.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Νοεμβρίου — «Αγίες Κυριαίνα και Ιουλιανή»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry enumerates two women, each with her own heading and her own city, so it is two folders. The corpus keeps five other Julianas — of Amisos, of Nicomedia, of Ptolemais, of Lazarevo, and the mother of Saturninus — and none of them is of Rhosus or kept on this day. The English form takes her city because the page gives it: «την πόλη Ρώσο επίσης της Κιλικίας». No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
